label: Nonmutual existential dependence from consistent strict grounding of existence facts (inference)
rule: Reuse Fine strict-grounding transitivity and irreflexivity to exclude reverse dependence
meaning: A genuine new conditional support option for the previously open distinct-being asymmetry claim: with a consistent PLG theory and a faithful strict-grounding interpretation of existential dependence edges, reversal yields a strict self-ground and inconsistency. Both input commitments remain open; the existing counterfactual dependence relation is not redefined or automatically a strict ground. This does not establish universal asymmetry, only the result under the selected interpretive configuration.
